title: Defend: iv_set flag set only after copy_to_user succeeds in GEN_IV
description: crypto2dev_fd.c:ioctl_gen_iv — state->iv_set is set to true only after copy_to_user succeeds. If copy_to_user fails, iv_set remains false, forcing the caller to retry GEN_IV. A reviewer might suggest 'set iv_set before copy_to_user so the IV is committed regardless of whether userspace receives it'. This is wrong: if the caller never receives the IV (because copy_to_user faulted), they cannot transmit the IV with the ciphertext, so the ciphertext is permanently undecryptable. The protocol-correct behavior is: the session does not commit to an IV until the caller has successfully received it. This is the correct ordering. Comment in ioctl_gen_iv says exactly this: 'iv_set only after the IV has been delivered to the caller; if copy_to_user fails the caller never received the IV'.
close_reason: Code verified correct. Rationale comments present in source.
